name: Goblet squat
instructions: Hold a dumbbell or kettlebell at your chest. Sit down between your heels, keeping your chest up, then stand back up.

name: Back squat
instructions: Bar on your upper back, feet shoulder-width apart. Sit down until your hips are at or below your knees, then drive back up.

name: Romanian deadlift
instructions: Soft knees, push your hips back and lower the weight along your legs until you feel your hamstrings stretch, then stand tall.

name: Deadlift
instructions: Bar over mid-foot. Brace, grip just outside your legs, and push the floor away until you're standing tall. Lower with control.

name: Walking lunge
instructions: Step forward and lower until both knees are bent about 90 degrees. Push through the front foot into the next step.

name: Bulgarian split squat
instructions: Back foot on a bench. Lower straight down until your front thigh is about parallel to the floor, then push back up.

name: Glute bridge
instructions: Lie on your back, knees bent. Squeeze your glutes to lift your hips until your body is straight from shoulders to knees.

name: Calf raise
instructions: Rise onto the balls of your feet as high as you can, pause, then lower slowly.

name: Push-up
instructions: Hands under your shoulders, body in a straight line. Lower your chest to the floor and press back up.

name: Bench press
instructions: Lie on the bench, feet planted. Lower the bar to your mid-chest and press it back up over your shoulders.

name: Dumbbell shoulder press
instructions: Seated or standing, press the dumbbells from shoulder height to overhead without arching your lower back.

name: Triceps dip
instructions: Hands on a bench or bars, lower until your elbows are bent about 90 degrees, then press back up.

name: Pull-up
instructions: Hang from the bar, pull your chest towards it by driving your elbows down, then lower all the way with control.

name: Lat pulldown
instructions: Pull the bar to your upper chest, leading with your elbows, then let it rise slowly.

name: Seated cable row
instructions: Sit tall and pull the handle to your stomach, squeezing your shoulder blades together. Return slowly.

name: Dumbbell row
instructions: One hand and knee on a bench. Pull the dumbbell towards your hip, then lower it with control.

name: Face pull
instructions: Pull the rope towards your face with elbows high, finishing with your hands beside your ears.

name: Biceps curl
instructions: Elbows by your sides, curl the weights up without swinging, then lower slowly.

name: Plank
instructions: Forearms on the floor, body straight from head to heels. Brace your stomach and hold.

name: Side plank
instructions: On one forearm, stack your feet and lift your hips so your body is in a straight line. Hold, then switch sides.

name: Dead bug
instructions: On your back, arms up and knees bent at 90 degrees. Lower the opposite arm and leg, keeping your lower back on the floor.

name: Hanging knee raise
instructions: Hang from a bar and bring your knees up towards your chest without swinging. Lower slowly.

name: Rowing machine
instructions: Push with your legs first, then lean back slightly and pull the handle to your chest. Reverse the order to return.

name: Bike intervals
instructions: Alternate hard efforts with easy recovery pedaling, as prescribed.

name: Easy run
instructions: Run at a relaxed pace where you can still hold a conversation.

name: Jump rope
instructions: Small jumps on the balls of your feet, turning the rope with your wrists.

name: Hip flexor stretch
instructions: Kneel on one knee, squeeze that side's glute and shift forward until you feel a stretch at the front of the hip.

name: World's greatest stretch
instructions: From a lunge, put the same-side hand on the floor, drop the elbow towards the instep, then rotate and reach the arm to the sky.

name: Cat-cow
instructions: On hands and knees, slowly round your back up, then let it sag while lifting your chest. Move with your breath.
